The guest is already waiting and looking right here.
Tell her that this is a special gift from the Chef.
I will smile and say the most polite words.
Go quickly, do not make an important person wait.

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Настоящий повар чувствует каждый вкус блюда.
examples.trans: A real chef feels every taste of the dish.

examples.text: Осталось ровно три минуты до готовности блюда.
examples.trans: Exactly three minutes remain until the dish is ready.
The chef prepared a delicious dish.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('important').

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.

meanings.note: Qualitative adjective formed with the productive suffix '-тельный'/'-ливый'. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('polite, courteous').

examples.trans: On the other hand she is calm and polite.

examples.text: Я улыбнусь и скажу самые вежливые слова.
examples.trans: I will smile and say the most polite words.

examples.text: Спасибо, я стараюсь быть очень вежливым.
examples.trans: Thank you, I try to be very polite.

вернуть.gloss: to give back, to get back

examples.text: Ты эти деньги через полгода вернёшь.
examples.trans: You'll get this money back in six months.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun
neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.
The most important thing is the people.

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)
meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('hot').

examples.trans: Careful, the cup is very hot.

examples.text: Аркаша, держи горячий чай. И бутерброд с вареньем ешь.
examples.trans: Arkasha, here's some hot tea. And eat a jam sandwich.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

examples.text: Все внимание! Гостья пробует блюдо новичка.
examples.trans: Attention everyone! The guest is tasting the newcomer's dish.
The guest is tasting the newcomer's dish.

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters
to a loved one, and at the start of letters

examples.text: В Москве вам дают деньги на дорогую одежду, а мозги не дают.
examples.trans: In Moscow they give you money for expensive clothes, but they don't give you brains.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('other, another, different').

examples.text: Послушайте, а можно в другое место? Здесь плохо пахнет.
examples.trans: Listen, could we go somewhere else? It smells bad in here.
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

заставлять.gloss: to force, to make (someone do something)

meanings.en: to force, to make, to compel

examples.trans: Who is making you torture anyone, Samson?

examples.text: Кто тебя заставляет пытать, Самсон? Мы так его припугнём, и всё.
examples.trans: Who is making you torture anyone, Samson? We'll just give him a scare, that's all.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Узнаёшь? У нас здесь ничего не изменилось.
examples.trans: Recognise it? Nothing has changed here.

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me

examples.trans: I think I've seen you somewhere.

meanings.note: not long in duration or length

examples.trans: I simply took a short break.
Fine, write up a short plan for the story.

meanings.note: Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'critic, reviewer' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: A strict critic is sitting in the hall.
The restaurant critic praised the bartender.

examples.text: К нам сегодня приедет ресторанный критик.
examples.trans: A restaurant critic will come to us today.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('personal, private').

examples.text: Всё, Нинок. Теперь у нас есть личный слуга.
examples.trans: That's it, Ninok. Now we have our own personal servant.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'minute' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I'll be there in ten minutes.

examples.text: Ладно, будь там. Через десять минут буду.
examples.trans: All right, stay there. I'll be there in ten minutes.

meanings.note: praise, said to a man, woman or child

examples.trans: I see, I see, you're a hero. Well done.

meanings.note: два года назад = two years ago

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago!

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил! Я сам приказ подписывал!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago! I signed the order myself!

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'стоящий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('real, genuine').

examples.text: Ваня, да пойми ты наконец! Это настоящий успех.
examples.trans: Vanya, understand at last! This is real success.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: Yulia, bring a pen and a piece of paper.

meanings.note: Common neuter noun meaning 'window' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: He is looking out the window.

examples.text: Все видели, как ты из окна летел.
examples.trans: Everyone saw you fly out the window.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Паша, я больше не хочу о ней слышать. Понял?
examples.trans: Pasha, I don't want to hear about her again. Understood?
There is special attention on the election.

examples.text: Потому что к выборам особое внимание. Самсонов — звезда!
examples.trans: Because there is special attention on the election. Samsonov is a star!

meanings.en: to hand over, give back, yield
meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'давать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hand over, give back'.

examples.text: Тимур, не наглей и отдавай товар!
examples.trans: Timur, don't get cheeky and hand over the goods!

examples.text: Федя, успокойся и отдавай срочные заказы!
examples.trans: Fedya, calm down and hand over urgent orders!

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to panic'.

examples.trans: Do not panic ahead of time.

examples.text: Вика, не паникуй, я уже несу горячее блюдо.
examples.trans: Vika, do not panic, I am already carrying the hot dish.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'арок'). Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'present, gift' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: This is a present for you.

examples.text: Это семейный праздник. Как в детстве, с подарками!
examples.trans: It's a family holiday. Like when we were kids, with presents!

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!
A course of the correct antibiotics.
We have prescribed a course of the correct antibiotics.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

examples.text: В смысле, Виктор Степанович? Прямо так, да?
examples.trans: What do you mean, Viktor Stepanovich? Just like that?

examples.text: Мы же только начинаем. Через месяц будет пять тысяч.
examples.trans: But we're only just starting. In a month there'll be five thousand.

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.
Do you know the main thing?

meanings.note: Секунду! = One second! / Just a moment!

examples.trans: One second. I'll call right now.
One second. I'll call Mishkin right now.
Why are you sitting in the corner?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

examples.trans: Let's go quickly to the studio!

meanings.note: 'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word
'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: The white one? Give me the keys.

examples.text: У нас есть большая тарелка рыбы и крабов.
examples.trans: We have a big platter of fish and crabs.
Put clean plates on the table.

examples.text: Успокойтесь, я ещё сделаю! Куда ставить тарелку?
examples.trans: Calm down, I'll make more! Where should I put the plate?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
Что-то голос какой-то не очень уверенный.
examples.trans: Your voice doesn't sound very confident.
He answered in a calm, confident voice.

examples.text: Что-то голос какой-то не очень уверенный. Что конкретно?
examples.trans: Your voice doesn't sound very confident. What specifically?

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'лыбнуться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to smile', paired with 'улыбаться'.

examples.text: Самсон, ну улыбнись. У нас мир.
examples.trans: Samson, come on, smile. We're at peace.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: outstanding work of art or skill

examples.trans: A masterpiece was made out of nothing.
This soup is a real masterpiece.
Well done. Practically a masterpiece out of nothing.
The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
